description: CMD_CODE 13 gateway-info response captured from live hardware 2026-09-10 (hub ST_2310401744, four sub-devices). data_str1 is the Wi-Fi SSID in plain text -- not hex, unlike nearly every other payload in this protocol. data_str2 packs the gateway room id in [0:2] and the sub-device push flag in [2:], where '00' means enabled. Field meanings traced to DeviceInfoActivity (wifiName) and GatewayDetailActivity (isEdgeGateway) in the vendor app. SSID replaced with a placeholder; the real one is a home network name.
